# JobVane — Tasks

## Recreation of ColorLib Jobpply

- Preview: https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/jobpply/
- New name: JobVane
- Stack: React 19 + Vite + Tailwind CSS 4 + TypeScript

## Sections implemented

- [x] Navbar (transparent → opaque scroll, mobile toggle, 2 CTA buttons)
- [x] Hero (full-width background, search form)
- [x] FeatureBar (blue bg, 4 feature cards)
- [x] TopCategories (light bg, 4 category cards with counts)
- [x] BrowseSpecialism (bg image + overlay)
- [x] HotJobs (job listings + sidebar agencies)
- [x] Testimonials (carousel with photos and ratings)
- [x] Candidates (blue bg, carousel)
- [x] Newsletter (purple bg, email form)
- [x] Footer (dark bg, 4 columns, Component Dock link)

## Design tokens

- Primary: #007bff (Bootstrap blue)
- Accent: #6c63ff (vibrant purple)
- Font: Nunito Sans (Google Fonts)
- Dark footer: #343a40
- Light section bg: #f8f9fa
